# Subsetix Kokkos

**Subsetix Kokkos** is a C++20 library for finite volume discretization on sparse adaptive geometries using Kokkos for performance portability.

## Overview

Subsetix Kokkos implements a novel **Compressed Sparse Row (CSR) of Intervals** data structure for 2D sparse domains, enabling:

- **Memory-efficient storage** of irregular 2D/3D geometries
- **Fast set algebra operations** (union, intersection, difference)
- **GPU compatibility** via Kokkos parallel framework
- **Adaptive mesh refinement** (AMR) support
- **Finite volume discretization** (FVD) layer for hyperbolic PDEs

## Key Features

### Core Architecture

- **CSR Interval Set** representation for sparse 2D domains
- **Kokkos-based** parallel kernels for device execution
- **Template-based design** for compile-time optimization

### FVD Layer

- **Policy-based design** (no runtime polymorphism for GPU)
- **Multiple numerical fluxes**: Rusanov, HLLC, Roe
- **MUSCL reconstruction** with limiters (Minmod, Superbee, etc.)
- **Time integrators**: RK1, RK2, RK3
- **MPI support** for distributed computing

### Backends

- Serial
- OpenMP
- CUDA (with GCC 12)

## Quick Start

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/sbstndb/subsetix_kokkos_agent3.git
cd subsetix_kokkos_agent3

# Configure and build (serial backend)
cmake --preset serial
cmake --build --preset serial

# Run tests
ctest --preset serial
```
